description: The data of a task.announced on config_change (architecture §3.14.4, implementation §10.1). The edit travels by Claim-Check in context_ref, with the shape of config_change.payload.schema.json, and the operator's proof covers it through payload_digest (implementation §9.2). The common fields are in data.schema.json.

context_ref.description: Where the edit is in the Context Store.

operator_proof.description: The operator's proof of the act, with act config_change (architecture §3.14.2, implementation §9.2).
